units.source_text: 记得下完这盘棋两三年之后，我曾接到大竹七段夫人的来信，提到他家有十六口人。

en.t: I remember that two or three years after this game was finished, I received a letter from the wife of O竹 seventh-dan, in which she mentioned that there were sixteen people in their household.

units.source_text: 我想，在一个十六口人的大家庭里，或许可以领略到七段的性格或生活作风，便想去拜访他家。

en.t: I thought that in such a large family of sixteen people, I might perhaps get a sense of the seventh-dan's character or way of life, and so I wanted to visit his home.

units.source_text: 后来，七段的父亲去世，十六口人变成了十五口，我曾去吊唁。

en.t: Later, the seventh-dan's father passed away, and the household of sixteen became fifteen; I went to offer my condolences.

units.source_text: 虽说是吊唁，也是在举行过葬礼一个月以后才去的。

en.t: Although I call it a condolence visit, I did not go until a month after the funeral had been held.

units.source_text: 这是我第一次拜访七段的家。

en.t: This was the first time I visited the seventh-dan's home.

units.source_text: 七段不在，夫人亲切地接待了我，把我请进了客厅。

en.t: The seventh-dan was not at home, and his wife received me kindly and invited me into the sitting room.

units.source_text: 夫人寒暄过后，站到门口去了。

en.t: After exchanging greetings, his wife went and stood by the doorway.
